purpose: Strict four-source paper-data sensitivity analysis in which every outer-fold target set is selected from the three development source maps only, then evaluated on the untouched laboratory/source anchor.

outer_split.target_selection: exact intersection of rank-eligible canonical accessions in the three development sources only

models.constant: development-target mean; Spearman is undefined by contract
models.full: unpenalized-intercept ridge on the frozen sequence feature table
models.composition_only: unpenalized-intercept ridge on frozen amino-acid composition features
models.standardization: development-partition mean and standard deviation; zero standard deviation replaced by 1.0

uncertainty.low_cluster_count_policy: report every fold's batch count and do not convert source, batch or technical-replicate counts into donor-level n

negative_control.alpha_policy: re-run nested alpha selection independently within every permutation
negative_control.monte_carlo_precision_note: This is a finite 64-resample QC null for the four-source sensitivity route; it is not used as a confirmatory p-value.

effective_sample_size.primary_independent_unit: unresolved biological unit; measurement batch is the inferential cluster
effective_sample_size.reporting_rule: report rows, targets, batches, laboratory/source anchors and unresolved donor status separately
effective_sample_size.prohibited_inference: no donor-level effective n from technical replicates, condition batches or pooled plasma

accounting_contract.fold_ledger_row_count: development plus held-out rows, repeated within each outer fold
accounting_contract.held_out_test_observation_count: sum of held-out source rows across folds, without development-row duplication
accounting_contract.prohibited_label: neither count is donor-level effective n

claim_boundary: This is a four-source, availability-aware exploratory sensitivity analysis using public paper/supplementary source maps. It does not establish independent biological validation, donor-level generalization, raw-MS reanalysis, evaluator lockbox performance, no-author reproduction, external adoption or scientific submission readiness.
